title: Loving Memories Event Center & Rentals

services.name: Rental
services.desc: Loving Memories Event Rentals offers a curated collection of à la carte décor and event essentials available for weddings and celebrations held anywhere-not just at our venue. From timeless tables and chairs to statement backdrops and thoughtful details, our rentals make it easy to design a beautiful event wherever you’re gathering. The venue or day of coordinator puts chairs at tables and secures cushions for event as well as stack chairs (in stacks of 6) with cushions removed and back in bags at end of event to have ready for Loving Memories Event Center & Rentals to place in the delivery vehicle.
